name: Gästehaus Tyrol
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Tyrol is located in Söll, Tyrol, Austria. The property is an inviting inn offering comfortable overnight accommodations. Set right in the village centre, it is conveniently close to the gondola lift. Guests enjoy access to an on-site restaurant serving hearty regional specialties. Guest rooms are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and functional furnishings. The house also features a relaxing lounge area and a terrace. Complimentary Wi-Fi and parking are provided, while the surrounding landscape is ideal for both hiking and skiing.
